notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.
